title: Shire
blurb: Aggregates Polish real-estate listings on one map, with a drive-time filter that hides anything outside your commute — built on OpenStreetMap and OSRM routing.
note: Best used on a desktop computer.

title: Peak Finder
blurb: Point your phone at a ridge, freeze the frame, and see the mountain peaks named over it. The whole resolver runs on-device in WebAssembly.
note: Use on a mobile phone — tested on iPhone 14 Pro.

title: RDR2 Inventory Tracker
blurb: Track crafting materials across Red Dead playthroughs, cell by cell. Works fully offline or synced to the cloud.

title: Pack — dog-walk manager
blurb: Roster and compatibility tracker for dog-walking groups: who walks well with whom, schedules and outcomes. English and Polish.

title: Dark — character graph
blurb: An interactive family-tree graph untangling the timeline-bending cast of Netflix's Dark.

title: Thinmaxer
blurb: A free weight-loss and meal-prep planner. Offline-first, with a Go and Postgres backend built behind a clean repository seam.

title: Shroommaxer
blurb: Wild-mushroom fruiting predictor and offline map of known spots across Poland. Private, two-user, behind basic auth.
